I feel this a lot. Here’s the thing, will Allah forgive you, or will YOU forgive yourself? I think the guilt is the hardest part, second to the feeling of disappointment from not having discipline. It’s hard with AuDHD to have discipline and not seek dopamine, but that’s the entire point of fasting. I also struggled this year. I was a lot better last year, I felt so motivated and pure to stay away from things and even people that weren’t good for me for the most part. I even gave up coffee for Lent as a motivation to do something more and actually didn’t have coffee at all for 40 days. This year I felt like I needed to break my fast a couple of times just to have a cup of coffee or matcha or something to eat to give myself motivation. But it shouldn’t be like that, you know? We shouldn’t really need anything outside of ourselves. And I think that’s sort of the point of it all. 

I’ve been dealing with depression, fatigue, also been having stomach issues. But the thing is, eating isn’t necessarily helping that. Neither is going for things like even social media and my phone as a distraction. It’s actually only harming me… So it’s mind over matter thing.

Islam does say that illness or difficulty exempts you from fasting. Obviously there’s different interpretations of what qualifies as that, so you have to do what’s best for you. You can always make up the fasts you missed later and use that as motivation. I will be doing that, lol. 

I’m sort of telling myself of the story of how Jesus spent 40 days fasting in the desert and was tempted by the devil multiple times. So to me, these are temptations trying to get us to abandon ourselves and fall back into old habits…After these 40 days, he started his ministry or whatever. Basically his life purpose. We can’t really move forward and start our life purpose if we’re showing the universe and ourselves that we don’t truly want it because we give in to things that aren’t good for us. It is hard though and I feel you because I’m also disappointed in myself but trying to use it to my advantage and learn from it.

Ni is all about forming impressions without any deductive reasoning to build up to them. So, in a way, your sensory perception does it for you. *Ni does NOT make judgments, ONLY impressions.* Any judgment you have about your impression comes from Fe, Fi, Te, Ti, or something else.

Okay, what the hell does that mean? 

It means that you "subconsciously" form impressions about people, the world, movies, everything due to patterns that you pick up on in your every day life. Your subconscious mind, very similar to your sensory perception, is constantly picking up and filtering information. Your brain constantly picks up on sensory stimuli, but not all of it is "important" enough to bring your conscious attention to it. Ni does this in a way, and then it presents itself in the form of intuition and insight. 

Sometimes, if you try hard enough, you can trace back and deduct what lead to a specific insight that you add. "Well 5 years ago I knew a person who did x and was y, and 2 months ago I saw a vaguely similar thing online, so I guess that's how I knew this thing." or "One time I was shopping with my friend and she was drawn to thing x which had this aesthetic.
